The original FBX is preserved. Rig-specific compositions are baked separately to
Assets/Resources/SecondIslandMotion using Tools/BuildSecondIslandMotions.cs.
Those compositions also reuse the existing CC0 KayKit character animation library
under Assets/ThirdParty/CapriPolishKayKit (license kept in that directory).
